fields.description: Issue features editorials and local political coverage focused on Miami Beach gambling enforcement and debate over a “liberal policy,” including discussion of Melvin Richard’s position and criticism of daily newspapers. Reports include a Hialeah “Peeping Tom” case before Judge Lavery, commentary on a proposed Dade County referendum on rent decontrol and on shortening the Dade school term, and summaries of Florida legislative actions and an expected special session. Additional items address medical-fee controversy involving Dr. R. M. I. Edelman and hospital care, immigration commentary regarding Finnish arrivals, traffic-safety messaging, and assorted local civic and crime notes.
